    Power Calculation for an Unpaired Comparative Diagnostic Accuracy Study with Co-Primary Endpoints

    unpaired_power_opt_bin.Rd

    The function determines the overall power for an unpaired comparative diagnostic accuracy study with co-primary endpoints (sensitivity and specificity) under the intersection–union testing (IUT) framework.

    Superiority and non-inferiority hypotheses may be specified independently for sensitivity and specificity.

    Sensitivity is evaluated in the diseased subgroup and specificity in the non-diseased subgroup. Power calculations are based on large-sample normal approximations for the difference between two independent binomial proportions.

    unpaired_power_opt_bin(
  N,
  prev,
  alpha,
  se.c,
  se.e,
  sp.c,
  sp.e,
  delta.se = 0,
  delta.sp = 0,
  type.se = c("sup", "ni"),
  type.sp = c("sup", "ni")
)

    Arguments

    N

    Total sample size.

    prev

    Disease prevalence (0 < prev < 1).

    alpha

    Type I error rate per endpoint.

    se.c

    Sensitivity of the comparator test.

    se.e

    Sensitivity of the experimental test.

    sp.c

    Specificity of the comparator test.

    sp.e

    Specificity of the experimental test.

    delta.se

    Non-inferiority margin for sensitivity (used only if type.se = "ni").

    delta.sp

    Non-inferiority margin for specificity (used only if type.sp = "ni").

    type.se

    Type of hypothesis for sensitivity: "sup" (superiority, default) or "ni" (non-inferiority).

    type.sp

    Type of hypothesis for specificity: "sup" (superiority, default) or "ni" (non-inferiority).

    Value

    An object of class `"dx_bin"` containing:

    • design specifications (design specifications (alpha level, testing framework, CI method)

    • achieved overall power,

    • endpoint-specific powers,

    • subgroup sample sizes.

    References

    Stark, M., Hesse, M., Brannath, W., & Zapf, A. (2022). Blinded sample size re-estimation in a comparative diagnostic accuracy study. BMC Medical Research Methodology, 22, 115. doi:10.1186/s12874-022-01564-2

    See also

    unpaired_ss_opt_bin

    Author

    Maia Muresan (DCR Bern)

    Examples

    unpaired_power_opt_bin(
N=910,
alpha=0.05,
se.c=0.75,
se.e=0.85,
sp.c=0.65,
sp.e=0.75,
prev=0.6
)
#> 
#> DxPower - Confirmatory Diagnostic Accuracy Study 
#> --------------------------------------------------
#> Design:            unpaired comparative design 
#> Framework:        Co-primary (IUT)
#> Alpha level:       0.05 
#> Prevalence:        0.6 
#> 
#> Hypotheses:
#>   Sensitivity :    sup 
#>   Specificity :    sup 
#> 
#> Achieved overall power:  1 
#> 
#> Endpoint-specific power:
#>   Sensitivity:      1 
#>   Specificity:      1 
#> 
#> Sample size per group:
#>   Total:            910 
#>   Diseased:         546 
#>   Non-diseased:     364 
#> 
unpaired_power_opt_bin(
N=910,
alpha=0.05,
se.c=0.75,
se.e=0.85,
sp.c=0.65,
sp.e=0.75,
prev=0.6,
delta.sp=0.05,
type.sp="ni"
)

#> DxPower - Confirmatory Diagnostic Accuracy Study 
#> --------------------------------------------------
#> Design:            unpaired comparative design 
#> Framework:        Co-primary (IUT)
#> Alpha level:       0.05 
#> Prevalence:        0.6
